Class AbstractDataRequestAcceptHandler

java.lang.Object
grafiosch.gtnet.handler.AbstractGTNetMessageHandler
grafiosch.gtnet.handler.AbstractResponseHandler
grafiosch.gtnet.handler.AbstractDataResponseHandler
grafiosch.gtnet.handler.AbstractDataRequestAcceptHandler
All Implemented Interfaces:
GTNetMessageHandler
Direct Known Subclasses:
DataRequestAcceptHandler
public abstract class AbstractDataRequestAcceptHandler extends AbstractDataResponseHandler
Abstract base class for handling data request accept response messages.

The entity kinds of the request being accepted come from AbstractDataResponseHandler; what is added here is the state an acceptance leaves behind — the grant that authorises the exchange from now on.
